[[Lukas|Lukas Vasburg]] is a [[Warrior]] [[henchman]] available in the Factions campaign. He's a member of [[Kurzick]] [[Great House]] of [[House Vasburg]]. Lukas specializes in [[Swordsmanship]] and [[Tactics]], dispatching enemies with self-declared prowess and style.

He is labeled as a [[Guardian Henchman]].

==Evaluation==
'''Pros'''
*Is durable and uses defensive skills.
*Has a powerful elite attack skill.
*Can [[Daze]] kiting foes.
*Uses Jaizhenju's Strike before he uses Sprint making full use of the skill's effect.
'''Cons'''
*Energy heavy build.
*Healing Signet decreases his durability when activating it.

==Dialogue==
Monastery Overlook
:''"I am Lukas. I am already quite legendary amongst the warriors of my people, the Kurzicks."''

Shing Jea Island town and outposts:
:''"The name is Lukas of House Vasburg, you seem like a pretty good sort. Why don't you make sure to stay close to me, and you'll learn what it takes to become a legend. That's right, I don't intend to become a mere hero, but truly legendary. Epic, you might say. The crux of the matter, of course, is not just accomplishing your goals but accomplishing them in true style. I will become the greatest of artists and the battlefield will be my canvas. Now, what is it you wanted?"''

Wajjun Bazaar
:''"Who wouldn't require the services of a hero such as me? There was little else to do on Shing Jea Island, so I figured I would come here."''

Echovald Forest:
:''"Can you believe that Danika still refuses to notice me? You would have thought I could get her attention after hiring those minstrels. What was that? You think I've made a mistake? Yes of course! The minstrels were rather droll of me, I think it's time to commission a statue~ or perhaps the writing of a play recounting my great deeds! It's hard to decide, perhaps I'll do both. My thanks for the advice, did you need something?"''

Divine Path:
:''"Can I ask a favor, <character name>? Danika seems to have a lot of respect for you. I still don't understand why she hasn't fallen for me. Do you think you could put in a good word for me? Not that I need it, of course, but every little bit helps."''

==Quotes==
Shing Jea Island towns and outposts:
:''"Who would like to fight by the side of the greatest warrior the world has ever known? That's right don't be intimidated by my prowess!"'' {{sic}}
:''"You there! You look like a capable sort, invite me to go with you and you too can take part in forging my legend!"''

Shing Jea Island:
:''"If only [[Danika]] were here to see me. In the entire world, only she is truly worthy of me."''
:''"It is an honor to fight by my side."''
:''"It's a shame they let [[Luxons]] into the [[Shing Jea Monastery|monastery]]. Of course they fight fairly well, but no style at all."''
:''"You should see how they treat me back home. I don't really like to brag about it, but I am something of a hero. [[People Know Me|People know me]]."''

Echovald Forest:
:''"Sometimes when I go into battle I hear music. Of course I paid a lot to commission those songs about me so it is a good thing that the music is so fetching, it sticks in one's head. A true testament to the subject matter!"''
:''"We've been through a lot, haven't we? It is times like these that make my soul reflect on courage and loyalty, the sort of bond that develops only between those who have shed blood together. A warrior could never ask for more stalwart followers that I have found in all of you."''
:''"With my homeland in peril and crying out for a hero to save the day, what else could I do but return?"''

===Battle quotes===
:''"Another victory for me!"''
:''"I make everything look so effortless."''
:''"I'm really left handed!"''
:''"Poorly done! Let me show you how to fight with some style!"''
:''"Saints of old guide my sword; if I should fall then guide my soul!"'' (same as [[Erys Vasburg|Erys]], possibly a [[House Vasburg]] battle cry)
:''"Sometimes I amaze even myself!"''
:''"That was a mightily struck blow, if I do say so myself."''
:''"The poets will write epics about this day!"''
:''"You will remember this as the day you were defeated by Lukas Vasburg."''

==Notes==
*Lukas appears to be wielding a [[Platinum Blade]] and a [[Gothic Defender]].
*He wears [[Warrior Kurzick armor]].

==Trivia==
{{gw2w|Lukas Vasburg}}
*The quote ''"I'm really left handed!"'' is possibly a reference to the sword fight in the film "[[w:The Princess Bride|The Princess Bride]]".
*The quote ''"Sometimes I amaze even myself!"'' is spoken by [[w:Han Solo|Han Solo]] in "[[w:Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope|Star Wars]]".
*The quote ''"You will remember this as the day you were defeated by Lukas Vasburg."'' is possibly a reference to Pirates of the Caribbean
*His skills were updated in the [[Game updates/20091022|22nd October 2009 update]].
**This added [[Jaizhenju Strike]], [[Quivering Blade]] (elite), [[Standing Slash]], and [["Watch Yourself!"]], and removed [[Dragon Slash]] (elite), [[Hamstring]], and [[Protector's Defense]] from his skills.
